import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    L=np.log(eps)
    p=params
    return (p[0]+p[1]*T+p[2]*T**2+p[3]*T**2.5
            + (p[4]+p[5]*T+p[9]*T**2)*L
            + (p[6]+p[7]*T)/eps + p[8]*eps**2)
